COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Binary Arithmetic Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Binary Arithmetic Operations.

2. When learning Computer Network Standards and Protocols, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.

3. When learning Web Development Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Web Development Fundamentals.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Web Development Fundamentals.

4. When learning Structured Query Language, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Structured Query Language.

5. When learning Relational Database Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Relational Database Fundamentals.

   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Relational Database Fundamentals.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Relational Database Fundamentals.

6. When learning Network Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Security.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Network Security.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. When learning Logic Gates, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Logic Gates.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Gates.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Gates.

11. When learning Object Oriented Programming Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Data Representation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Binary Arithmetic Operations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Logic Gates and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Logic Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
